A bundle that throws Error('bad') makes main return 1 and write 'bad' to stderr

bash scripts/build-workflows.sh produces skills/runtime/runner.js whose first line starts with '// @generated — DO NOT EDIT. Source: skills/src/', and the script's verify stage fails if that banner is missing
The datum-* loop's meta/return post-processing is not applied to runner.js, and existing bundles are byte-identical apart from changes in their own sources
package.json dependencies are unchanged
DAT-18.red_note: skills/src/runtime/runner-main.test.ts calls the exported main(argv, io) with injected stdout and stderr writers against temp bundle, args and config files. It asserts the exact stdout JSON, exit 0 and exit 1 with the stderr message. tests/test_build_runner_bundle.py (pytest) runs `bash scripts/build-workflows.sh` via subprocess with an argv list (no shell=True) and a timeout. It asserts skills/runtime/runner.js exists with the @generated banner on line 1 and does not start with `export const meta`. Both fail today. skills/runtime/runner.js is a generated file: never list or hand-edit it, the build produces it.

DAT-19.title: datum workflow run <name> command
acceptance_criteria: `datum workflow run fixture --args a.json` with a stub runner printing '{"r":1}' prints {"r":1} on stdout and exits 0
A runner that exits 1 with 'boom' on stderr makes the command exit 1 with 'boom' on stderr

Exit 2 with a message on stderr for each of: bundle found in neither directory, args file missing, args file not JSON, config with no runtime block, runtime.kind unknown ('runtime_kind_unknown: <kind>'), and runtime.kind 'pi' ('runtime_kind_unavailable: pi', Q5 default)
The runner is spawned via subprocess with a list argv (no shell=True, no os.system) and an explicit timeout
The bundle lookup prefers .datum/skills/<name>.js over <skills_dir>/<name>.js
The datum/cli.py addition is under 15 lines, and tests/test_cli_flag_contract.py passes unchanged
pyproject.toml dependencies are unchanged
DAT-19.red_note: tests/test_workflow_run_cli.py uses typer.testing.CliRunner (or subprocess) in a tmp_path repo with .datum/config.json and .datum/skills/<name>.js. It points the command at a stub runner, a tiny node or python script injected via a module-level runner-path seam in workflow_run.py, so tests do not need a built runner.js. It asserts stdout JSON and exit 0, exit 1 with stderr passthrough, and one test per exit-2 cause with its exact message. It fails because there is no `workflow` sub-app. The runner argv contract (--bundle/--args/--config/--repo-root/--skills-dir) comes from task-018.

DAT-20.title: Collector reads metrics.jsonl for per-agent-type, per-stage and cached-share totals
acceptance_criteria: Given metrics.jsonl lines for agent_type 'datum-red' (prompt 100, completion 10, cached 40) and 'datum-green' (prompt 0), per_agent_type['datum-red'] == {calls: 1, prompt_tokens: 100, completion_tokens: 10, cached_tokens: 40}
per_stage keys are label prefixes (text before the first ':') with the same four totals
cached_share['datum-red'] == 0.4 (rounded to 4 decimals), and cached_share['datum-green'] == 0.0 when prompt_tokens is 0
A missing metrics.jsonl yields per_agent_type == {}, per_stage == {} and cached_share == {} with exit 0, and the existing status semantics are unchanged
A malformed line 3 makes the collector exit non-zero with a message containing 'line 3'
The existing tests in tests/test_closeout_collectors.py and tests/test_closeout_cli.py pass unchanged, and per_phase output is unchanged
DAT-20.red_note: tests/test_closeout_token_metrics_jsonl.py (pytest) builds a tmp repo with .datum/runs/<runId>/metrics.jsonl, using the exact key set produced by task-013. It runs the collector as a module via subprocess with an argv list and a timeout, then asserts the exact per_agent_type, per_stage and cached_share dicts, the empty-dict case for a missing file with exit 0, and the non-zero exit naming 'line 3' for a malformed line. These fail because the collector reads only SQLite today.
